limits: The six unique-name joins use the user-authorized elimination method across all four national registers, not uniqueness in this guide alone.
A general bank-directory link on johanes.sk alone was insufficient; the ministry account entry includes the distinguishing medical and postgraduate titles.
Council candidates may have voluntary accounts. Danko and Sokol namesakes were not excluded merely because an account is not obligatory for them.
Sokol homepage returned HTTP 466 to the plain reader. Its canonical /kandidat/ page returned HTTP 200 and directly displayed the matching IBAN and Žilina mayor candidacy.
No donor names, private contact details, counterparty IBANs, balances, payment amounts or personal addresses are reproduced.
Other candidacies remain not_exhaustive because this focused name recheck did not refresh the whole guide or all candidate rosters. Personal spending and campaign operators remain unknown.

Independent review rejected upgrading Danko based on a transaction memo. Transaction participation is not legal ownership; a voluntary council account remains possible. No ambiguous bank URL or IBAN is retained in the public data or this receipt.
